audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart hands Levels 2, 3 and First item to Vayne while every matching 'why' on the same rows says Neeko chunks her, kills her, and owns the lane. The packet chart also reads Neeko for rows 1-5.
audit.why: phases[1..5].side / win[1..5] disagree with whys[1..5], breakdown.mid ('This is your takeover'), early ('winnable'), and packet.levelChart [Skill, Neeko, Neeko, Neeko, Neeko, Neeko, Vayne]. A 65.38% win rate over 26 games supports early Neeko control with a late Vayne reclaim.
audit.corrected: Rows 1-5 to Neeko, row 6 stays Vayne, row 0 stays Skill — proposed as one atomic group in both layers.

audit.why: Four spikes present and correctly ordered: Lvl 2-3 Q+E, Lvl 6 Pop Blossom (R 120/105/90s), 1st item Lost Chapter/Liandry's, 2+ items Vayne's crit core. The late row correctly marks the hand-off.

audit.whatIsWrong: Tumble is treated only as a dodge tool; the pages never say it is an auto-attack reset, which is the actual tell that her burst has started. Condemn's real cooldown (20/18/16/14/12) and 550 range are never given.
audit.why: Riot: 'Vayne tumbles... Her next attack deals bonus damage' with the autoReset flag — the wind-up after the Tumble is the commit, not the Tumble itself. Condemn is the ability that both cancels a Pop Blossom channel and wall-stuns, so its cooldown is the whole green-light system.
audit.corrected: State the Tumble reset as the step-back cue and give Condemn's 20s rank-1 cooldown.

audit.why: Tumble is 6/5/4/3/2s at 300 range; Condemn 20/18/16/14/12s at 550. Both make the advice concrete.

audit.whatIsWrong: The whole full layer calls Vayne 'he' and 'his' — tldr, enemyWin, ahead, trades, dosFull, dontsFull, report.
audit.why: Vayne is female; the content layer already uses 'she'. Only the tldr sits inside the length band cleanly, so I fixed that one rather than force-fitting the rest.
audit.corrected: Champion-wide pronoun sweep is worth a tooling pass — flagged in notes.

edits.before: His mobility dodges your root — bait the dash with a clone, then land E on the landing spot.
edits.after: Tumble dodges your root — bait it with the clone, then E her landing spot before Condemn.

edits.before: Wall-stun — never fight her with terrain at your back. Bait it, count it, then go.
edits.after: Condemn wall-stuns — never fight with terrain behind you; it's down 20s at rank 1.

edits.before: Your second Q point gives poke she cannot trade back at level 2 since her tumble has no cooldown safety yet.
edits.after: Your second Q point out-ranges her 300-range Tumble, and at 6s rank 1 it is not up to answer every poke.

notes: Level-chart rows 1-5 were proposed as one atomic pair-matched group; row 0 (Skill) and row 6 (Vayne) unchanged. Champion-wide issue: the entire full layer refers to Vayne as 'he/his' (enemyWin, ahead, tradeGood, dosFull, dontsFull, report[3], report[11], report[13]) — the content layer correctly says 'she'. That is a mechanical pronoun sweep, not per-matchup prose, so I did not burn the length band on it. Also unverified: text claims Neeko can 'go invisible' with W — Riot's W description says it sends a clone and grants bonus damage/move speed, no invisibility. Left alone, logged below.
